'''Holodeck Adventures''' is the 28th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 21 December 2001. The set consists of 142 cards. This expansion had been planned since 1995.

This set features cards from favorite holodeck episodes, from Dixon Hill and the town of Deadwood to Secret Agent Julian Bashir and Captain Proton. Holographic personnel and equipment, holodeck "personae" of main characters, and other holodeck-themed cards are complemented by new Delta Quadrant missions, Q-icon cards, and many long-awaited "broken links" fixes.

This set is available in 11-card booster packs and there are 36 booster packs in 1 booster box. Each pack contains 1 rare card and a mix of 6 common and 4 uncommon cards.

[[Decipher]] issued a double-sided Rules Supplement and Card List sheet inserted into each booster pack.

This set is noted for the following:
*Introduced holodeck 'personae' of main characters and other holodeck-themed (holoprograms) cards
*Included was the Ultra-Rare '''Dixon Hill''' card found in 1:121 packs and another range of Rare+ cards (33% more rare than the normal Rare)
*Introduced the first 'black & white' (monochrome} cards depicting the Captain Proton cards/adventures
*Resolved the broken link with the Barash icon (from the [[Introductory Two-Player Game (expansion)|Introductory Two-Player Game]])
*Due to production problems at the time, a misprint of Holosuite was released, with both the misprint and correct versions included in packs
